subject: Kickoff: Skyline AI customer endorsement — scope, logistics, and release flow
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Skyline AI — video endorsement kickoff

Team —

Skyline (Alex Moreno) agreed to a short on-camera endorsement focused on how Redwood reduced inference spend and simplified deployment across their infra. We have roughly 20–25 minutes of on-camera time and they'd like a small crew (1 DP + sound). Goals: capture a short customer story (~90s final), two b-roll sequences (office, product screen), and a quick quote for our homepage.

Ask: can you help scope studio needs, a draft talking-track, and the standard release path? I attached the initial brief from Marissa (v1) and a simple release template I grabbed from Legal last quarter.

High-level constraints from Skyline: Nov 16–18 availability window; strict NDAs around specific PII in internal dashboards; prefer in-office shoot (NYC).

Next steps I propose:
- Marissa: draft two short talking points and a run-of-show (I left bullets in the brief)
- Dev: confirm crew/kit estimate and whether Redwood can cover travel + kit or if Skyline will provide
- Rachel: coordinate logistics and confirm insurance/KPIs for vendor

Thanks — short turnaround on this, Alex is excited but has limited dates.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Manager, Customer Marketing | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: shoot-brief-v1.pdf (brief), release-template-draft.docx (release template)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Skyline AI — video endorsement kickoff

Thanks — quick notes and a talking-track draft below. Kept it tight for a 90–120s final.

Proposed talking points (short form):
1) Problem statement (10–15s): "We were spending too much to keep our models responsive across regions..."
2) What changed (25–30s): "Redwood gave us predictable latency and a consistent API across hosted and on-prem..."
3) Outcome (30–40s): "We cut token costs by ~X% and improved 95th percentile latency..."
4) Callout (15s): specific feature: Dedicated capacity + routing fallbacks

Run-of-show (15–20 min capture):
- 00:00–02:00: establish interview, 2 camera angles, tight questions per point
- 02:00–05:00: B-roll — team at desk, model results on screen (mocked/blurred)
- 05:00–10:00: Additional pick-ups, optional mic swap, sound check

Legal/release notes: we should send Skyline our release form and a short on-camera guidelines doc (privacy: redact PII from screens). I attached a cleaned version of the release and an on-camera do/don't doc.

I'll finalize a one-page script for Alex to review before we send externally.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: Skyline_release_form_v1.pdf, on-camera-guidelines.docx

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@skylineai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0500
Subject: Redwood x Skyline — script + release for your review

Alex —

Thanks again for agreeing to do this. Per our call, please find: (1) a short script/talking points we hope you'll use, (2) a simple release to sign, and (3) a brief shoot checklist. We kept everything editable — if you want to shorten or reframe any point, totally fine.

Draft talking points (one-page):
- Intro: name, role, short description of Skyline AI (5–8s)
- Challenge: latency/cost constraints with prior setup (12–15s)
- How Redwood helped: dedicated capacity, routing, predictable egress (25–30s)
- Impact: quant or qualitative result (15–20s)
- Closing: one-line advice for peers (8–10s)

Attached: Skyline_release_form_v1.pdf (fill & sign), on-camera-guidelines.docx, shoot-shot-list.pdf

Proposed shoot dates: Nov 16 (AM), Nov 17 (flex), Nov 18 (PM). Can you confirm preferred date and whether you want a remote shoot instead?

If you want to run a prep call the week prior, Marissa and I are free Thursday the 12th.

Best,
Mina

Attachments: Skyline_release_form_v1.pdf (attachment stub), on-camera-guidelines.docx (attachment stub), shoot-shot-list.pdf (attachment stub)

From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@skylineai.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Redwood x Skyline — script + release for your review

Hi Mina —

Thanks — the talking points look great and align with our messaging. We can do Nov 17 in the morning at our Manhattan office (10:00–12:00). I reviewed the release; a couple of small redlines:
- Section 3 (use of product screenshots): please add that Skyline reviews final assets for redaction of sensitive pipelines
- Add a short clause about speaker attribution (we prefer role + company, not personal email)

I'll have our legal ops send a signed copy once the two clauses are added. For the shoot, we'd prefer Redwood to bring the camera kit and DP — Skyline can provide a quiet meeting room and a product engineer for pick-ups.

Looking forward to it. Prep call on Nov 12 works for me; 11:00 ET?

Cheers,
Alex
Head of Product, Skyline AI
alex.moreno@skylineai.com
+1 (212) 555-0133

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Redwood x Skyline — kit/insurance/vendor confirmation

All —

Confirmed: Redwood will book a DP + small kit and handle travel. Estimated cost (travel + day rate + liability): $2,200. I'll route this through Vendor Ops; Rachel, can you confirm vendor insurance limits and the internal PO by Monday?

I also updated the release with the two clauses Alex requested and attached a clean PDF for legal signoff (Skyline_release_form_v1.pdf). If Legal needs additional language about PII redaction we can add a short appendix.

Prep call: Nov 12, 11:00 ET — calendar invite sent.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Production Lead | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com

Attachments: Skyline_release_form_v1.pdf (updated)
